    StartersBobsled team beef pattiesFlaky pastry filled with spiced beef, thyme and scotch bonnetHow to make it400g beef mince1 brown onion1 bunch thyme1/2 scotch bonnet chilli1 tsp allspice1 tsp curry powder3 sheets of shortcrust pastry1 tsp ground turmericChop the onion and chilli finely.Fry the mince with the onion, thyme, chilli, allspice and curry powder, then cool.Cut the pastry into rounds and brush with turmeric water. Fill, fold and crimp.Bake at 200°C.Plantain chips with lime chilli mayoThin fried green plantain chips salted with lime zest, chilli mayo to dipHow to make it3 green plantains1 L vegetable oil2 limes1/4 scotch bonnet chilli150g whole egg mayonnaisesalt, to tastePeel the plantains by scoring the skin lengthways and prising it off. Slice very thin with a mandoline.Heat the oil to 175°C and fry in batches until crisp, then drain on paper towel.Toss with salt mixed with lime zest.Stir the mayonnaise with lime juice and finely chopped chilli for dipping.Sanka's lucky jerk devilled eggsSanka kisses his lucky egg before every runHow to make itAs written, serves 4Halved boiled eggs with yolks whipped with mayo, jerk seasoning and lime, piped back in and topped with spring onion and a pinch of smoked paprika.Lower 8 eggs into simmering water and cook 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel.Halve and tip the yolks into a bowl.Mash with 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tsp jerk seasoning, the juice of half a lime and a pinch of salt until smooth.Pipe or spoon back into the whites.Finish with sliced spring onion and a dusting of smoked paprika.Give one a kiss before eating.Jamaican festival dumplingsFeel the rhythm, feel the rhyme.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsCalgary '88 jerk chickenJerk marinated chicken grilled until charred, rice and kidney beansHow to make it2 scotch bonnet chillies2 tsp allspice1 bunch thyme4 spring onions3 garlic cloves2 limes4 chicken marylands300g long grain rice1 tin kidney beans200ml coconut milkBlitz the chillies, allspice, thyme, spring onions, garlic and lime juice into a paste and coat the chicken.Marinate in the fridge overnight.Grill slowly over coals until charred and cooked through.Cook the rice with the drained kidney beans and coconut milk.Calgary curry goat with rotiWarm food for a Jamaican team in a Canadian winterHow to make itAs written, serves 4Goat shoulder marinated in curry powder, garlic and thyme, browned then braised slowly with potato and scotch bonnet, served with warm roti and lime pickle.Toss 1.2kg diced goat or lamb shoulder with 3 tbsp curry powder, 4 crushed garlic cloves, thyme and salt and marinate overnight.Brown in batches in a heavy pot with 2 tbsp oil.Add a diced onion, a whole scotch bonnet and 750ml chicken stock, cover and simmer gently for 2.5 hours.Add 500g diced potato and cook 30 minutes more until the sauce thickens.Warm 8 roti in a dry pan and serve with lime pickle.SweetsJamaican coconut toto cakeSpiced coconut tray cake with nutmeg and gingerHow to make it125g soft butter200g brown sugar2 eggs250g plain flour2 tsp baking powder1 tsp ground nutmeg1 tsp ground ginger100g desiccated coconut250ml coconut milk2 limes80g caster sugar200ml coconut creamHeat the oven to 180°C and line a 20 by 30cm tray.Beat the butter with the brown sugar, add the eggs, then stir in the flour, baking powder, ground nutmeg, ground ginger, coconut and coconut milk.Bake.Simmer the lime juice with the caster sugar and pour over the warm cake.Serve with whipped coconut cream.DrinksCool Runnings sorrel ginger punchHibiscus steeped with ginger, cloves and orange peel, sweetened and chilledHow to make it30g dried hibiscus flowers1 piece fresh ginger4 whole cloves2 oranges120g caster sugar300ml pineapple juice2 limes1.2 L waterBring the water to the boil with the hibiscus, sliced ginger, cloves and the peel of one orange.Turn off the heat and steep, then strain.Stir in the sugar until dissolved and chill.Mix with the pineapple juice and lime juice. Pour over ice and garnish with orange slices.
